reply.headline: Typical rain, temperature, snow and wind for Paiporta, Valencia, Spain on 15 May 2024.
why: Recent rain over the last 6 days set the level: Normal rain for the last 6 days (0.3 mm).
Totals like this happen about 45 times a year here now, and the 0.3 mm includes measured rain for earlier days plus the forecast for the day itself.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 34 km/h) and normal highs for here (feels like up to 22 °C) also fit the pattern, with no snow forecast.
Days like this were about 51 times a year in 1951–1980, which does not make this day any less serious, because the level is based on the recent 30 years.
